what: breakout_1 feed snapshots post realized_today=null. Every scheduled tick of ict-prop-feed prints 'account_unparsed: realized_today': the terminal's 'Day RPL' (ACCOUNT_LABELS['realized_today'], src/prop/platform/dxtrade.py) does not parse from the page. MEASURED 2026-09-28 09:01-09:17Z (diag issue #13545; prop_account_status ids 22-26). Each feed row becomes the latest status, so compute_rule_distance reports day_pnl_state='realized_unreported' and distance_to_daily_loss=None. The daily-loss cushion on the operator's panel therefore goes from 'measured' (the manual report, id 21) to unknown ('—'). That is honest, not fabricated, but it loses information on an account-killer limit. Fix: get the real label/structure of the Day RPL metric (a breakout-login-check run's --dump-dir page_text on the VM, or the structure dump) and fix the selector; never default it to 0.
